name: Molly control
author: Brett
description: Every Molly screen, tab, setting and action reachable without the UI (molly-shell@1): Molly hands the console inside it a catalog of its own screens, settings tabs, dialogs and actions (embed@1 host-catalog); the console announces them with its own, so the console API (REST), the MCP tools (console_open, console_action, console_list, console_where), the CLI (axf console …) and voice through AmberX reach Molly exactly like the console, and the console carries each command back up (host-run). No second server, no second sign-in. Settings → Plugins → Molly control: on / off, a note per command, what reached Molly last.

items.title: Switch to an app
items.description: Brings an app's first copy on screen. Same as: axf console open <app> (the console inside Molly resolves Molly's screens).

items.title: New tab (another copy of an app)
items.description: Opens another copy of an app (console → Console 2) as its own tab; in IDE mode as a dock tab. Same as: axf console action molly.new-tab console.

items.title: Close a tab
items.description: Closes a copy of an app (its frame goes). Without an instance: the one on screen. Same as: axf console action molly.close-tab console#2.

items.title: Next tab
items.description: Steps to the next open copy.

items.title: What Molly shows now
items.description: molly-shell@1 state: view, app, open copies and which are on screen, IDE mode, the apps that joined. Read it with: axf console where (the console inside Molly answers with Molly's screen) or axf console list screens molly.

commands.noReads: no data folder: Molly's state is per browser tab (session storage) and read through the console's where / list
